Please find my annotated redlines attached (high level summary below). I kept commercial terms conservative and flagged a few items for sales sign-off:
- Data residency: we can commit to US-only region storage and processing in the SOW; add reference to our published region list and include caveat for customer-requested exports.
- Access & support: we will require MFA and scoped access for any support sessions; include requirement for advance notice for privileged access.
- Indemnity & liability: recommend capping indemnity at $2M and carving out direct IP claims; we should not accept uncapped consequential damages.
- SLA credits: standard 10% service credit for monthly availability below SLA threshold; do not accept high-dollar termination for SLA misses.
- Early-termination: propose pro-rated refund of unused reserved units less a 30-day termination processing fee.

I attached redlines: redlines_brightarc.docx
